newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaichi Int Cap halts deals with Yamaichi Sec.
newsitem.headline: Yamaichi Int Cap halts deals with Yamaichi Sec.

text.p: Yamaichi International Capital Management Co Ltd halted stock and bond transactions through Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd on Wednesday, a senior official at the capital management firm said.
The move came after prosecutors raided Yamaichi Securities looking for evidence of suspected illegal stock deals, he said.
The official said it was not clear how long the suspension of business with Yamaichi would last.

A spokeswoman for Yamaichi International Capital Management said the firm is five-percent owned by Yamaichi Securities. The remaining 95 percent is held by other firms in the Yamaichi Securities group, she said.
